public.title: Permutations
public.description: Return every permutation of values in lexicographic order by numeric values. values contains 0 to 6 distinct integers from -100 to 100. The empty input has one permutation, []. Do not depend on the original input order.
hints: At each depth, choose only unused values.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Backtracking visits unused choices in increasing order, producing lexicographic permutations. O(n*n!) time and O(n) auxiliary space plus output.
